title: qcr review --json, version 1
description: One JSON object per line from `qcr review` (also `--to json`), `qcr review start`, `status` and `stop`. schema_version leads every payload; ok says whether the call succeeded. Fields beyond those named may appear without a version change; a caller ignores what it does not know and refuses a schema_version it does not know. A failure is {ok:false, errors:[…]}; a review stopped at its cap is {ok:false, partial:true, coverage, …} with the findings written before the stop.

errors.description: Why the call failed; present when ok is false and no result exists.

partial.description: True when the review stopped at its cap before finishing.

stopped.description: True when the caller stopped the review (the review API's abort signal) before it finished: {ok:false, stopped:true, errors:[…]}. Nothing is recorded or posted; what the round wrote stays in its out dir.

coverage.description: Which planned lenses had started when a capped review stopped.

findings.description: This round's findings by severity (P0, P1, P2, … nit, other), worst first.

still_open.description: Findings from earlier rounds that are still open.

unchanged.description: True when nothing new was reviewed because the branch had not changed.

out_dir.description: The run's output directory, with the findings record and stage files.

report.description: Path of the markdown report, when the file destination was asked for.

customised.description: True when a profile (the user's, or the repo's .qcr/ on the base commit) replaced a shipped agent or prompt with different bytes for this review; overrides lists them.

overrides.description: The shipped files a profile replaced; empty unless customised.

run_id.description: A detached run's id (start, status, stop).

progress.description: While a detached run is running: the lenses started so far.

live.description: The running round's live log, projected: what the parent and each lens are doing now.

duration_ms.description: The lens's time so far; a running lens's counts from its start between updates.

tool_count.description: Tool calls the lens has started; a finished lens keeps its final count.

current_tool.description: The running (or last) tool, as `<tool>: <args>` or the bare name.

current_target.description: While the lens runs: the path its current tool works on, when it names one.

line.description: The lens as one line a person reads: `security · read src/x.ts · 7 tools · 0:41`.

result.description: A finished detached run's last JSON line: the review's own result (null if it printed none).

timed_out.description: status --wait gave up after --timeout; the run is still going.

path.description: The shipped file, relative to the app root (agents/pass-security.md).

layer.description: The profile whose file won (.qcr for the repo profile).

seed.description: True when the shipped file is a frozen seed.

kind.description: What is reviewed: a pull request, the current branch against its base, the uncommitted working tree, or a unified diff handed in (`--diff`). Only a pr target can be posted.

uncommitted.description: A branch target reviewed together with the working tree's uncommitted edits, as one review. Absent otherwise.

postable.description: True when a PR is behind the target, so --to pr applies.

head_sha.description: The reviewed head; for a diff target a hash of the diff's text.

since.description: Delta rounds: the head the earlier review was of.

fallback_reason.description: Why a follow-up round is a full review, not a delta.

cap_usd.description: The hard stop; null on the Action route without --limit.

auto.description: True when the review runs without a confirmation.

key.description: Quote it with --key to confirm a review over the limit.

post.description: What --to pr did. In a dry-run install the review is recorded, not sent.
